title: Finite and infinite frieze patterns from p-angulations and a generalization of Weyl groupoids
summary: A classic result of Conway and Coxeter on frieze patterns has been generalized to a bijection between $p$-angulations of regular polygons and frieze patterns of type $Λ_p$. One of the features of Conway-Coxeter theory is a combinatorial procedure to obtain from the triangulation all entries of the corresponding frieze pattern. We first present a combinatorial algorithm, involving Chebyshev polynomials, for obtaining from a dissection all entries of the corresponding frieze pattern.
